high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from Lindsey Graham's Twitter account (@LindseyGrahamSC). The tweet reads: "Looking forward to beginning the One Big Beautiful Bill soon. Started the day with @POTUS and thanked him for his leadership. Let’s Go!" The tweet includes a photo of two men standing on a golf course. The man on the left is wearing a white polo shirt, black pants, and a red cap with "Make America Great Again" written on it. He is giving a thumbs-up gesture. The man on the right is wearing a blue polo shirt, khaki shorts, and white sneakers
